t: This is Canon Row, a historic street in Westminster, best known today for Canon Row Police Station. The person linked to this spot is William Stanley, the sixth Earl of Derby, who was born here. He came from a prominent but precarious position, since his mother was in line to succeed Queen Elizabeth I. After travelling in Europe as a young man and winning a long legal battle that secured his standing, he kept a careful distance from national politics. He devoted himself instead to administration and cultural projects, including writing plays.
